name: Welcome Modal UI
description: Startup workspace picker modal with overlay, open button, and recent workspaces list.

dom.root: .welcome-overlay (position: fixed, inset: 0, background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6), display: flex, align-items: center, justify-content: center, z-index: 10000)
children: .welcome-modal (background: var(--surface), border: 1px dashed var(--border), border-radius: 8px, padding: 32px, min-width: 400px, max-width: 500px)
.welcome-modal h2 (text: 'Welcome to Cockpit IDE', font: Space Mono, margin-bottom: 24px)
.welcome-modal .open-btn (text: 'Open Workspace', button styling per DESIGN.md, margin-bottom: 16px)
.welcome-modal .recent-list (unordered list of recent workspace paths, each clickable)
.welcome-modal .recent-item (block: path text, overflow: hidden, text-overflow: ellipsis, cursor: pointer, padding: 4px 0)

interactions.name: open_workspace
interactions.action: IPC workspace:select (native directory picker) → If path selected, resolve promise with path → Close modal
interactions.result: Promise resolves with workspace path string

interactions.name: select_recent
interactions.action: Read data-path attribute → Resolve promise with that path → Close modal
interactions.result: Promise resolves with recent workspace path

interactions.name: close
interactions.action: Resolve promise with null → Remove overlay from DOM
interactions.result: Promise resolves with null (no workspace selected)

states.open: Overlay visible (display: flex), modal centered, recent list populated from IPC workspace:recentWorkspaces
